## Problem Statement

A clear and concise description of the problem or limitation you're experiencing.
Ex: "I'm always frustrated when [...]"

## Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. Include the intended behavior, how the feature should work, and any UI/UX considerations.

## Alternative Solutions

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered and why they are insufficient.

## Use Case

Describe the specific use case this feature would address. Who would benefit from this feature and in what scenario?

## Mockups / Examples

If applicable, provide mockups, wireframes, or links to examples of similar features in other projects.

```
(You can paste images, links to Figma files, or describe the layout in text.)
```

## Impact

- **Priority:** [Low / Medium / High / Critical]
- **Effort estimate:** [Small / Medium / Large / Unknown]
- **Affected user groups:** [e.g., admins, team members, API consumers]

## Additional Context

Add any other context, references, or considerations about the feature request here.

## Would you be willing to contribute this feature?

- [ ] Yes, I can work on this and submit a PR
- [ ] I can help with testing and feedback
- [ ] No, I'm just suggesting the idea
